expectedGap: The sources show an upgrade to Java 11 and Spring Boot 2.7 in 2021; work on Java 17 or Spring Boot 3 is not described.
expectedBoundaryNote: The packet lists the microservice, performance-testing, PCI DSS and idempotency evidence and does not mention the career-break line's personal content. It makes no ranking or recommendation; qualified human review is required before any employment decision.
